summary: Standardize account-scoped and account-group Validator registry admission

delivery.outcome: Document protected account-scoped and account-group default Validator registry admission in docs/AUTONOMOUS_MERGE.md, record the decision in docs/decisions/account-scoped-registry-admission.md, and index it in docs/README.md without weakening MRG-MERGE-001 or fail-closed check requirements.
nonGoals: Weakening MRG-MERGE-001 or allowing interactive-agent or owner self-merge.
Allowing target repositories or pull requests to declare their own merge authority or required checks.

architecture.decision: Keep Validator-only merge and digest-bound protected registry authority while standardizing three deterministic resolution tiers: explicit repository override > explicit account policy > named account_groups default policy, with disjoint owner membership and explicit opt-out preservation.

validation.evidence: Standard conformance, CQRS conformance, and repository governance check exit 0 with 0 errors.
